q: The complexity class MIP* (multiprover interactive proofs with entangled provers) was shown by Ji-Natarajan-Vidick-Wright-Yuen (2020, MIP*=RE) to satisfy:
opts: MIP* = RE (recursively enumerable) — the class of all computably enumerable languages
exp: MIP*=RE (JNVWY, 2020): the power of multiprover interactive proofs with quantum-entangled provers is exactly RE — all computably enumerable problems! This refuted Tsirelson's conjecture (C*-algebra), resolved Connes' embedding conjecture (negatively), and showed quantum entanglement between provers is enormously powerful.
